function.name: technique_label_collector
function.description: The id of Cyber threat attack atomic triplets is be classified with the Technique label. The function is used to collect the array of the triplet id of the same Technique label

technique.description: The tag name of the Technique, which is the head in the line. The line format is 'tag name:(Sentence numbers matching this tag);'

items.description: The number of the triplets, which is in the bracket in the line. The line format is 'tag name:(Sentence numbers matching this tag);

triplets_ids.description: The array of numbers of the triplets,
